title: Quietly Creamy Uruguayan Beef Wrap
description: A low-calorie, umami-rich Uruguayan dish featuring chives and served in a paella pan, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch. This recipe uses ssam-wrap for a unique and creamy twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the softened cream cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the chopped chives and stir to combine.
Warm the ssam-wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the beef mixture onto a ssam-wrap piece and serving immediately.
Squeeze a sliver of lime juice over the top of each wrap before serving.
